title: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS) 112
eligibility: All citizens needing immediate Police, Fire, or Ambulance services
benefits: Single unified emergency number across MP
GPS location tracking of caller for quick response vehicle (FRV) dispatch
application_process: Step 1: Dial 112 or trigger emergency SOS via 112 India App
Step 2: Emergency Response Centre (ERC) dispatches nearest First Response Vehicle
